evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes incompatible rules about creating games; other stories build on game existence.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with joining via URL and team-size limit; no story forbids URL-based invites.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires a different mechanism that contradicts entering an item to start a round.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with other stories about listing/browsing items; no conflicting visibility restriction is stated.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Aligns with re-estimation and item list management; no story prevents selecting prior items.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids adding items; consistent with viewing/editing/deleting items.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story states items are immutable; consistent with item management features.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires items to be undeletable; deletion is compatible with listing and selection.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately ... even though not all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Does not contradict the rule that estimates are shown after all have estimated; it adds an override capability for the moderator.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with entering an agreed estimate and auto-fill; no story forbids using averages.

evaluations.evidence: filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Auto-fill is consistent with manual entry/acceptance; no conflicting rule about always manual entry.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manual entry coexists with accepting average and auto-fill; no incompatibility stated.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with selecting items for re-estimation; no story prohibits re-estimation.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with copy/paste alternative; no story forbids importing.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Alternative mechanism to import; not incompatible with spreadsheet import.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with viewing/exporting transcripts; no story disallows access to previous games (unless deleted).

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with exporting transcripts and browsing games; no conflicting retention rule except deletion removes data.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Coexists with CSV export; no story forbids local saving.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Coexists with HTML export; no incompatibility.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game, so that stories and estimates for this game are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Deletion is compatible with browsing/viewing/exporting as long as the game exists; no story requires undeletable storage.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with login/change/delete account; no story contradicts having accounts.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with account creation and password reminder; no conflicting authentication method mandated.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids changing details; consistent with account lifecycle.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account, so that account information and games are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with browsing/viewing previous games only while the account exists; no story requires retaining games after account deletion.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: No other story specifies a conflicting timezone display requirement.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with account/login stories; no story forbids email-based reminders.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: No other story fixes a single mandatory card sequence; consistent with ordering cards across draws.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires inviting more than 15 or unlimited estimators; thus no incompatibility.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with moderator inviting via URL; no story requires account login for estimators.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with moderator selecting items and participants viewing item lists.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Matches moderator visibility of items; no story restricts participants from seeing the list.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Does not conflict with hiding estimate values until reveal; it only reveals that an estimate was submitted and by whom.

evaluations.evidence: shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with moderator override to show early; also compatible with showing submission status without values.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with changing estimate until draw completion; no story states estimates become locked earlier.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Conflicts with the requirement to store results in a non-identifiable way; showing per-estimator prior estimates requires linking estimates to a specific estimator identity across time.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with revealing estimates after all have played (or moderator forces reveal); no story forbids attribution once revealed.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes incompatible timer behavior.

evaluations.evidence: timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with having a shared timer; no story specifies a different reset condition.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with transcripts and viewing prior estimates within a game; no story forbids in-session history.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with allowing different card sets; ordering can be consistent within the chosen set.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Same rule as PP-034 expressed more generally; not incompatible.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: No other story prohibits displaying participant identity cues; potential privacy tension is not stated as a hard prohibition except for research storage.

evaluations.evidence: compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Non-functional requirement compatible with browser support and accessibility requirements.

evaluations.evidence: list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: No other story contradicts having a glossary.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Performance-related implementation detail does not conflict with other stated behaviors/constraints.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with standards compliance and accessibility; no story requires dropping support for these browsers.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes incompatible UI constraints; aligns with standards and broad browser support.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires slow responses or conflicting performance constraints.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: No other story restricts character sets or mandates ASCII-only input.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with URL-based invitations; no story requires opaque or unpredictable URLs.

evaluations.evidence: nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: No other story contradicts providing user-friendly error handling.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Incompatible with stories that require showing per-estimator historical estimates, which implies identifiable linkage of estimates to a specific estimator.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics can be aggregated and does not inherently contradict other requirements; no explicit incompatible constraint is stated.
